title: Pete and These Hens
lines: Pete has five hens and Eve is best.
Pete hunts for Eve by the lake.
She is not in the tall grass.
Steve the cat naps on a stone.
Steve gets up and Eve hops off.
"She is brave," said Pete with a grin.

questions.ask: Which hen is Pete hunting for?
questions.listenFor: Eve. Her name is in the first line, so send them back to it.

questions.ask: Where does Pete find Eve in the end?
questions.listenFor: On Steve the cat's back. If they say "the lake", ask them to read the line about Steve again.

questions.ask: Do you think Steve minds having a hen on his back? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason, such as "no, because he just gets up and walks off."
